posts.text: Hacker News advice to founders: skip the PR agency, post your funding round yourself, you'll rank better. Five searches of HN's own archive found zero data behind that rule, no dang quote, no 120x stat, nothing. What is real: HN moderator dang swapped Temporal's Series B post for a third-party article mid-thread in 2022. He does this to press releases, not founders vs PR.
